title: Engineering Economics
description: Engineering Economics develops cash-flow analysis and decision methods—time value of money, equivalence, present/annual/future worth, rate of return, benefit-cost, depreciation, taxes, inflation, replacement, and risk—for evaluating engineering alternatives.
